acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: When a mysterious, ripped-open package arrives on Pablo's doorstep, he takes it as a sign.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Pablo flies closer to the sun.
acts.title: Icarus

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: In Greek mythology, a three-headed dog named Cerberus guards the gates to Hades, making sure only those who are actually dead get in. This story is about a real person who had that job in America — a 25-year veteran of the Social Security Administration who was asked, in a secret meeting with DOGE, to declare 6,000 living people dead. He said no. Then the list grew to 2.7 million.
acts.title: Cerberus

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
A mortal gets the assignment of a lifetime — to go interview an actual god who is living on earth, traveling under the name of Lionel Messi.
This story was adapted from the podcast The Away End, hosted by Daniel Alarcón and John Green.
acts.credits: By Daniel Alarcón; Produced by Emmanuel Dzotsi
acts.title: Zeus
